candidates.gloss_en: 23 trials on 13k children... what does 'slows' myopia mean?

beats.new_info: the eye grows longer, power increases
beats.spoken: قصر النظر يتقدم لما العين تطول.

beats.new_info: on average axial length growth is ~0.15 mm less and refraction ~0.31 D less than with single-vision lenses
beats.spoken: بالمتوسط العين تطول أقل بحوالي ٠.١٥ ملم، وتقدّم القوة أقل بحوالي ٠.٣ دايوبتر.

beats.new_info: slowing, not stopping; designs differ; individual response varies
beats.spoken: هذا تبطئة مو إيقاف، وتختلف حسب التصميم والطفل.

beats.new_info: decision belongs to the child's eye professional

claims.text: Specialty lenses slowed progression on average in 23 RCTs
claims.support_quote: 23 RCTs with a total of 13.315 subjects
claims.scope: children and adolescents; pooled vs single-vision lenses; AL -0.15 mm, SER -0.31 D; design-specific

candidates.hook_ar: تقليل قوة نظارة الطفل ما يبطّئ قصر النظر… وممكن يسرّعه.

beats.new_info: poses the question: Is that really true? (carried by text)

beats.new_info: use the prescribed power and ask about options
beats.spoken: استعمل القوة المكتوبة، واسأل المختص عن الخيارات.

claims.text: Binocular undercorrection does not slow myopia progression and may accelerate it
claims.support_quote: undercorrection does not slow myopia progression; instead, it may even accelerate the progression
claims.scope: review of RCTs; children; one paired-eye monovision study showed the opposite for the undercorrected eye

candidates.risk: Review excerpt only (primary RCTs not opened)
